slides.lead: How to cut it down so you actually ship.

slides.h2: "Just one more feature" is how apps die.
slides.lead: Every extra screen is another week. Another thing to fix. Another reason not to launch.
If a feature doesn't help solve that sentence, it waits.
Build that loop first. Make it work end to end. Everything else is decoration.
Nobody leaves your app because dark mode isn't there on day one.
These aren't optional on the App Store. Budget time for them from the start.

points: Does it solve the one problem?
Can a user finish the core loop?
Yes to all three? Ship it.

slides.h2: Small and live beats big and perfect.
